rows.source_ko: 농림축산식품부 (농촌정책과-총괄), 044-201-1517, 1516
rows.text_en: Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs ( Rural Policy Division - General Affairs ), 044-201-1517, 1516

rows.source_ko: 제1조(목적) 이 규칙은 「농업ㆍ농촌 및 식품산업 기본법」 및 같은 법 시행령에서 위임된 사항과 그 시행에 필요한 사항을 규정함을 목적으로 한다. <개정 2015. 12. 23.>
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the Framework Act on Agriculture, Rural Community and Food Industry and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act, as well as matters necessary for the implementation thereof. <Amended Dec. 23, 2015>

rows.source_ko: 제1조의2(농식품이용권의 지급 등) ① 「농업ㆍ농촌 및 식품산업 기본법 시행령」(이하 “영”이라 한다) 제16조의3제1항에 따라 「농업ㆍ농촌 및 식품산업 기본법」(이하 “법”이라 한다) 제23조의3제1항에 따른 농식품이용권(이하 “농식품이용권”이라 한다)을 지급받으려는 사람은 별지 제1호서식의 농식품이용권 지급 신청서에 다음 각 호의 서류를 첨부하여 특별자치시장ㆍ시장(「제주특별자치도 설치 및 국제자유도시 조성을 위한 특별법」 제11조제2항에 따른 행정시의 시장을 포함한다)ㆍ군수 및 자치구의 구청장(이하 “시장등”이라 한다)에게 제출해야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1-2 (Payment of Agri-food Vouchers, etc.) ① Any person who wishes to receive an agri-food voucher (hereinafter referred to as “agri-food voucher”) pursuant to Article 23-3, Paragraph 1 of the Framework Act on Agriculture, Rural Community and Food Industry (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”) pursuant to Article 16-3, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree of the Framework Act on Agriculture, Rural Community and Food Industry (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”) shall submit an application for payment of agri-food vouchers in the form of Annex No. 1, along with the documents listed in each of the following subparagraphs, to the Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, Mayor ( including the Mayor of an administrative city pursuant to Article 11, Paragraph 2 of the Special Act on the Establishment of Jeju Special Self-Governing Province and the Creation of an International Free City ), County Governor, and Head of a Self-Governing District (hereinafter referred to as the “Mayor, etc.”).

rows.source_ko: 1. 「모자보건법」 제2조제1호에 따른 임산부임을 증명하는 의료기관의 진단서[영 제16조의2제1항제1호가목2)의 경우만 해당하며, 법 제23조의2제2항 및 제3항에 따라 확인되는 경우에는 해당 서류의 제출을 갈음할 수 있다]
rows.text_en: 1. A medical certificate from a medical institution proving pregnancy pursuant to Article 2, Subparagraph 1 of the Maternal and Child Health Act [applicable only to the case of Article 16-2, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 1, Item (a) 2) of the Enforcement Decree, and may substitute the submission of such document if confirmed pursuant to Article 23-2, Paragraphs 2 and 3 of the Act ]

rows.source_ko: 2. 신분증명서 사본[신분증 원본(모바일 신분증을 포함한다. 이하 같다)을 제시함으로써 해당 서류의 제출을 갈음할 수 있다. 이하 같다]
rows.text_en: 2. Copy of identification document [The submission of the relevant document may be substituted by presenting the original identification document (including mobile ID cards; hereinafter the same applies)]

rows.source_ko: 3. 대리인이 신청하는 경우에는 다음 각 목의 서류
rows.text_en: 3. In the case of an application by a representative, the following documents

rows.source_ko: 가. 대리인의 신분증명서 사본
rows.text_en: a. Copy of the representative's identification document

rows.source_ko: 나. 별지 제2호서식의 농식품이용권 지급 신청 위임장
rows.text_en: B. Power of Attorney for Application for Payment of Agri-food Vouchers ( Form No. 2)

rows.source_ko: 4. 농식품이용권의 수급자 자격 및 수급금액의 적정성을 확인하기 위해 필요하다고 농림축산식품부장관이 인정하여 고시하는 자료
rows.text_en: 4. Data designated by the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs as necessary to verify the eligibility of recipients and the appropriateness of the benefit amount for agri-food vouchers.

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따른 농식품이용권 지급 신청서를 제출받은 시장등은 「전자정부법」 제36조제1항에 따른 행정정보의 공동이용을 통하여 다음 각 호의 서류를 확인해야 한다. 다만, 신청인이 확인에 동의하지 않는 경우에는 해당 서류를 첨부하게 해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② The mayor, etc. who receives an application for payment of agri-food vouchers pursuant to Paragraph 1 shall verify the documents in each of the following subparagraphs through the joint use of administrative information pursuant to Article 36, Paragraph 1 of the Electronic Government Act . However, if the applicant does not consent to the verification, the applicant shall be required to attach the relevant documents.

rows.source_ko: 1. 「국민기초생활 보장법」에 따른 국민기초생활수급자증명서
rows.text_en: 1. Certificate of National Basic Living Recipient pursuant to the National Basic Living Security Act

rows.source_ko: 2. 「가족관계의 등록 등에 관한 법률」에 따른 가족관계등록전산정보(가족관계증명서에 기록된 등록사항에 관한 정보에 한정한다)
rows.text_en: 2. Computerized family relationship registration information pursuant to the Act on Registration of Family Relations, etc. (limited to information regarding registered matters recorded in a family relationship certificate)

rows.source_ko: 3. 「주민등록법」에 따른 주민등록표등본
rows.text_en: 3. Certified copy of the resident registration record pursuant to the Resident Registration Act

rows.source_ko: 4. 「출입국관리법」에 따른 외국인등록사실증명
rows.text_en: 4. Certificate of Alien Registration pursuant to the Immigration Control Act

rows.source_ko: ③ 시장등은 영 제16조의3제3항에 따라 농식품이용권을 지급하는 경우 다음 각 호의 사항이 포함된 농식품이용권을 지급해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ When the mayor, etc. issues agri-food vouchers pursuant to Article 16-3, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree , they shall issue agri-food vouchers that include the following items:

rows.source_ko: 1. 농식품이용권 수급자의 성명
rows.text_en: 1. Name of the recipient of the agri-food voucher

rows.source_ko: 2. 농식품이용권의 일련번호
rows.text_en: 2. Serial number of the agri-food voucher

rows.source_ko: 3. 그 밖에 농식품이용권의 사용에 필요한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Other matters necessary for the use of agri-food vouchers

rows.source_ko: ④ 제1항부터 제3항까지에서 규정한 사항 외에 농식품이용권의 신청 및 지급 등에 필요한 사항은 농림축산식품부장관이 정한다.
rows.text_en: ④ In addition to the matters prescribed in paragraphs 1 through 3, matters necessary for the application and payment, etc. of agri-food vouchers shall be determined by the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs .
[This Article Newly Inserted Jan. 22, 2026]

rows.source_ko: 제1조의3(전담기관의 지정 등) ① 영 제16조의4제2항에서 “농림축산식품부령으로 정하는 전담기관 지정신청서”란 별지 제3호서식의 전담기관 지정신청서를 말한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1-3 (Designation of Dedicated Agency, etc.) ① In Article 16-4, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree, the term “application for designation of a dedicated agency prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs” refers to the application for designation of a dedicated agency in Form No. 3 of the Appendix.

rows.source_ko: ② 영 제16조의4제2항에서 “농림축산식품부령으로 정하는 서류”란 다음 각 호의 서류를 말한다.
rows.text_en: ② In Article 16-4, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree, “documents prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs” refers to the documents in each of the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 1. 영 제16조의4제1항제1호에 해당하는 기관 또는 법인임을 증명하는 서류
rows.text_en: 1. Documents proving that it is an institution or corporation falling under Article 16-4, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree

rows.source_ko: 2. 영 제16조의4제1항제2호에 해당하는 조직 및 인력 현황에 관한 서류
rows.text_en: 2. Documents regarding the status of organization and personnel falling under Article 16-4, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree

rows.source_ko: 3. 영 제16조의4제1항제3호에 따른 정보시스템 구축ㆍ운영을 위한 기술적 능력에 관한 서류
rows.text_en: 3. Documents concerning technical capabilities for the establishment and operation of information systems pursuant to Article 16-4, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree

rows.source_ko: ③ 영 제16조의4제2항에 따라 제1항에 따른 신청서를 제출받은 농림축산식품부장관은 「전자정부법」 제36조제1항에 따른 행정정보의 공동이용을 통하여 다음 각 호의 서류를 확인해야 한다. 다만, 신청인이 사업자등록증명(주민등록번호가 제외된 것을 말한다. 이하 같다)의 확인에 동의하지 않는 경우에는 해당 서류를 첨부하게 해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ Pursuant to Article 16-4, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree , the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs who receives an application under Paragraph 1 shall verify the documents in each of the following subparagraphs through the joint use of administrative information pursuant to Article 36 , Paragraph 1 of the Electronic Government Act . However, if the applicant does not consent to the verification of the Certificate of Business Registration (referring to one excluding the resident registration number; hereinafter the same applies), the applicant shall be required to attach the relevant document.

rows.source_ko: 1. 법인 등기사항증명서(신청인이 법인인 경우만 해당한다)
rows.text_en: 1. Certificate of Corporate Registration (applicable only if the applicant is a corporation)

rows.source_ko: 2. 사업자등록증명
rows.text_en: 2. Business Registration Certificate
[This Article Newly Inserted Jan. 22, 2026]

rows.source_ko: 제1조의4(과징금의 납부통지) 영 제16조의7제1항 및 제3항에 따른 과징금의 납부통지 및 영수증은 별지 제4호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 1-4 (Notice of Payment of Penalty Surcharge) The notice of payment and receipt for penalty surcharges pursuant to Article 16-7 , Paragraphs 1 and 3 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 4 of the Attached Form .
[This Article Newly Inserted Jan. 22, 2026]

rows.source_ko: 제2조(전업농업인의 육성) ① 법 제26조제2항에 따른 전업농업인(專業農業人)으로 선정될 수 있는 사람은 다음 각 호의 요건을 모두 갖춘 농업인으로 한다. <개정 2013. 3. 24., 2015. 12. 23., 2026. 1. 22.>
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Fostering of Full-time Farmers) ① Persons eligible to be selected as full-time farmers pursuant to Article 26, Paragraph 2 of the Act shall be farmers who meet all of the requirements of each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Mar. 24, 2013; Dec. 23, 2015; Jan. 22, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 1. 농업을 주업(主業)으로 하며, 전문농업기술과 경영능력을 갖추고 농업 발전에 선도적인 역할을 할 수 있는 농업인일 것
rows.text_en: 1. Must be a farmer whose primary occupation is agriculture, who possesses specialized agricultural skills and management capabilities, and who can play a leading role in agricultural development.

rows.source_ko: 2. 농림축산식품부장관, 광역시장ㆍ도지사 및 특별자치도지사(이하 “시ㆍ도지사”라 한다) 또는 시장ㆍ군수 및 구청장(광역시 자치구의 구청장을 말한다. 이하 “시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장”이라 한다)이 정하는 기준에 적합한 농업인일 것
rows.text_en: 2. Must be an agricultural producer who meets the standards set by the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs, the Mayor of a Metropolitan City, the Governor of a Province, or the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province (hereinafter referred to as “Mayor/Provincial Governor”), or the Mayor, County Head, or District Head (referring to the head of a self-governing district in a Metropolitan City; hereinafter referred to as “Mayor/County Head/District Head”).

rows.source_ko: ② 시ㆍ도지사 또는 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 제1항에 따른 전업농업인에게 농업경영에 필요한 자금을 우선적으로 지원할 수 있다. <개정 2015. 12. 23.>
rows.text_en: ② The Governor of a City or Province or the Mayor, County Governor, or District Head may provide preferential financial support necessary for agricultural management to full-time farmers pursuant to Paragraph 1. <Amended Dec. 23, 2015>

[Wholly Amended Jan. 26, 2012]
[Title Amended Dec. 23, 2015]

rows.source_ko: 제3조(기계화영농사의 육성) ① 법 제34조제3항에 따른 기계화영농사(機械化營農士)는 기계화영농종사자 또는 기계화영농을 희망하여 농촌에 정착할 사람으로서 시ㆍ도지사가 지정하는 훈련과정을 이수하고 일정 수준 이상의 성적을 취득한 사람 또는 기계 분야 국가기술자격증 소지자 중에서 선정하여야 한다. <개정 2012. 1. 26., 2015. 1. 6., 2015. 12. 23.>
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Fostering of Mechanized Farmers) ① Mechanized farmers pursuant to Article 34, Paragraph 3 of the Act shall be selected from among those engaged in mechanized farming or those who wish to settle in a rural area for the sake of mechanized farming, who have completed a training course designated by the Mayor or Provincial Governor and obtained a grade of a certain level or higher, or who hold a national technical qualification certificate in the field of machinery. <Amended Jan. 26, 2012; Jan. 6, 2015; Dec. 23, 2015>

rows.source_ko: ② 시ㆍ도지사는 제1항에 따라 기계화영농사로 선정된 사람에게 기계화영농사증을 수여하여야 한다. <개정 2012. 1. 26., 2015. 12. 23.>
rows.text_en: ② The Mayor or Provincial Governor shall confer a Mechanized Farming Certificate upon a person selected as a Mechanized Farming Professional pursuant to Paragraph 1. <Amended Jan. 26, 2012; Dec. 23, 2015>

rows.source_ko: ③ 시ㆍ도지사는 기계화영농사에 대한 교육훈련과 그 지도활동에 필요한 지원을 할 수 있다. <개정 2012. 1. 26., 2015. 12. 23.>
rows.text_en: ③ The Mayor or Provincial Governor may provide support necessary for education and training of mechanized farmers and guidance activities thereof. <Amended Jan. 26, 2012; Dec. 23, 2015>
④ Deleted <January 26, 2012>
[Title amended Dec. 23, 2015]

rows.source_ko: 제4조(농업인의 전업 및 재취업 지원) ① 법 제39조제4항 및 제5항에 따른 전업 및 재취업 지원의 대상은 전업이나 재취업을 희망하는 농업인 및 실직농업인으로 한다. <개정 2015. 12. 23.>
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Support for Change of Occupation and Re-employment of Farmers) ① The subjects eligible for support for change of occupation and re-employment pursuant to Article 39, Paragraphs 4 and 5 of the Act shall be farmers who wish to change occupations or become re-employed, and unemployed farmers. <Amended Dec. 23, 2015>

rows.source_ko: ② 법 제39조제5항제1호에 따른 직업훈련 지원은 제1항에 따른 대상자 중 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 사람에 대하여 우선적으로 실시할 수 있다. <개정 2015. 12. 23.>
rows.text_en: ② Support for vocational training under Article 39 , Paragraph 5, Subparagraph 1 of the Act may be provided preferentially to persons falling under any of the following subparagraphs among the subjects under Paragraph 1. <Amended Dec. 23, 2015>

rows.source_ko: 1. 농지 등을 매도한 농업인
rows.text_en: 1. Farmers who have sold farmland, etc.

rows.source_ko: 2. 「한국농어촌공사 및 농지관리기금법」 제19조제3항에 따라 소유한 농지를 장기임대한 농업인
rows.text_en: 2. Farmers who have leased out farmland they own on a long-term basis pursuant to Article 19 (3) of the Korea Rural Community Corporation and Farmland Management Fund Act

rows.source_ko: 3. 농외소득의 증대가 필요한 영세농업인
rows.text_en: 3. Small-scale farmers who need to increase non-agricultural income
③ Deleted <December 23, 2015>

rows.source_ko: ④ 제1항 및 제2항 외에 농업인의 전업 및 재취업 지원에 관한 세부사항은 농림축산식품부장관이 정한다. <개정 2013. 3. 24., 2015. 12. 23.>
rows.text_en: ④ In addition to Paragraphs 1 and 2, detailed matters concerning support for the change of occupation and re-employment of farmers shall be determined by the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs . <Amended Mar. 24, 2013; Dec. 23, 2015>
[Title amended Dec. 23, 2015]

rows.source_ko: 제5조(기후변화에 따른 농업ㆍ농촌 영향 및 취약성 평가 등의 내용 및 방법 등) ① 법 제47조의2제1항에 따른 지구온난화 등 기후변화가 농업ㆍ농촌에 미치는 영향과 기후변화에 따른 취약성에 대한 조사ㆍ평가(이하 “기후영향평가등”이라 한다)는 분야별로 다음 각 호의 내용이 포함되어야 한다. <개정 2015. 12. 23.>
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Contents and Methods of Assessment of the Impacts of and Vulnerability to Climate Change in Agriculture and Rural Areas) ① The investigation and assessment of the impacts of climate change, such as global warming, on agriculture and rural areas, and of their vulnerability to climate change pursuant to Article 47-2, Paragraph 1 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as “climate impact assessment, etc.”) shall include the following matters for each sector. <Amended Dec. 23, 2015>

rows.source_ko: 1. 농업(임업은 제외한다. 이하 같다)ㆍ농촌 분야
rows.text_en: 1. Agriculture (excluding forestry; hereinafter the same applies) and rural sectors

rows.source_ko: 가. 농업ㆍ농촌에 영향을 미치는 기상ㆍ기후의 이상(異常) 변화에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: a. Matters concerning abnormal changes in weather and climate affecting agriculture and rural areas

rows.source_ko: 나. 농작물재배ㆍ축산의 적지(適地) 및 생산성 변화에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: B. Matters concerning suitability for crop cultivation and livestock farming and changes in productivity

rows.source_ko: 다. 돌발 및 외래 병해충ㆍ잡초의 이상 발생 및 피해에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: C. Matters concerning the abnormal occurrence and damage caused by sudden and alien pests and weeds

rows.source_ko: 라. 농업생태계의 생물다양성 및 생물계절 변화에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: D. Matters concerning biodiversity and phenological changes in agricultural ecosystems

rows.source_ko: ② 기후영향평가등 및 법 제47조의2제2항에 따른 실태조사(이하 “실태조사”라 한다)는 그 시기ㆍ대상 및 방법 등이 포함된 계획을 세워 실시한다.
rows.text_en: ② Climate impact assessment, etc. and the status survey pursuant to Article 47-2, Paragraph 2 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as the “status survey”) shall be carried out by establishing a plan that includes the timing, targets, and methods thereof.

rows.source_ko: ③ 기후영향평가등과 실태조사는 관측, 실험 또는 설문 등을 통한 직접조사와 관련 자료의 이용 등을 통한 간접조사의 방법을 통하여 실시한다.
rows.text_en: ③ Climate impact assessments and status surveys shall be conducted through direct investigation methods, such as observation, experiments, or surveys, and indirect investigation methods, such as the use of related data.

rows.source_ko: ④ 농림축산식품부장관은 법 제47조의2제1항에 따라 기후영향평가등의 결과를 공표하기 전에 제6조에 따른 농업ㆍ농촌 기후영향평가 자문위원회의 검토를 거쳐야 한다. <개정 2015. 12. 23.>
rows.text_en: ④ The Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs shall have the results reviewed by the Advisory Committee on Climate Impact Assessment for Agriculture and Rural Areas under Article 6 before publishing the results of the climate impact assessment, etc., pursuant to Article 47-2, Paragraph 1 of the Act . <Amended Dec. 23, 2015>

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 농림축산식품부장관은 법 제47조의2제1항에 따라 기후영향평가등의 결과를 인터넷 홈페이지에 게시하는 방법으로 공표하여야 한다. <개정 2015. 12. 23.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs shall publish the results of the climate impact assessment, etc., pursuant to Article 47-2, Paragraph 1 of the Act by posting them on the internet homepage. <Amended Dec. 23, 2015>

[This Article Newly Inserted Dec. 12, 2014]
[Title Amended Dec. 23, 2015]

rows.source_ko: 제6조(농업ㆍ농촌 기후영향평가 자문위원회) ① 농업ㆍ농촌 분야 및 임업 분야 기후영향평가등과 실태조사에 대하여 농림축산식품부장관의 자문에 응하기 위하여 농림축산식품부장관 소속으로 농업ㆍ농촌 기후영향평가 자문위원회(이하 이 조에서 “위원회”라 한다)를 둔다.
rows.text_en: Article 6 (Advisory Committee on Climate Impact Assessment for Agriculture and Rural Areas) ① An Advisory Committee on Climate Impact Assessment for Agriculture and Rural Areas (hereinafter referred to as the “Committee”) shall be established under the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs to provide advice to the Minister regarding climate impact assessments, etc. and fact-finding surveys in the agriculture, rural, and forestry sectors.

rows.source_ko: ② 위원회는 위원장 1명을 포함한 15명 이내의 위원으로 구성한다.
rows.text_en: ② The committee shall be composed of no more than 15 members, including one chairperson.

rows.source_ko: ③ 위원회의 위원장은 농림축산식품부 차관이 되며, 위원은 다음 각 호의 사람이 된다.
rows.text_en: ③ The chairperson of the committee shall be the Vice Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs, and the members shall be the persons listed in the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 1. 농림축산식품부, 농촌진흥청 및 산림청의 고위공무원단에 속하는 공무원 중 해당 기관의 장이 지명하는 사람 각 1명 이상
rows.text_en: 1. At least one person designated by the head of each agency from among public officials belonging to the Senior Civil Service of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs, the Rural Development Administration, and the Korea Forest Service.

rows.source_ko: 2. 기후ㆍ생태ㆍ농업ㆍ임업ㆍ농촌 등에 관한 학식과 경험이 풍부한 사람으로서 농림축산식품부장관, 농촌진흥청장 또는 산림청장이 추천하는 사람 중에서 위원장이 위촉하는 사람 10명 이내
rows.text_en: 2. No more than 10 persons appointed by the Chairperson from among those recommended by the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs, the Administrator of the Rural Development Administration, or the Administrator of the Korea Forest Service, who possess extensive knowledge and experience regarding climate, ecology, agriculture, forestry, rural areas, etc.

rows.source_ko: ④ 제3항제2호에 따른 위원의 임기는 3년으로 한다.
rows.text_en: ④ The term of office for a member pursuant to Paragraph 3, Subparagraph 2 shall be three years.

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 위원회의 위원장은 위원회의 회의를 소집하고 그 의장이 된다.
rows.text_en: ⑤ The chairperson of the committee convenes the committee meetings and presides over them.

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 위원회의 위원장이 부득이한 사유로 그 직무를 수행할 수 없을 때에는 위원장이 미리 지명한 위원이 그 직무를 대행한다.
rows.text_en: ⑥ When the Chairperson of the Committee is unable to perform their duties due to unavoidable circumstances, a member designated in advance by the Chairperson shall perform the duties on their behalf.

rows.source_ko: ⑦ 위원회의 회의는 재적위원 과반수의 출석으로 개의하고, 출석위원 과반수의 찬성으로 의결한다.
rows.text_en: ⑦ Meetings of the Committee shall be opened with the attendance of a majority of the registered members, and decisions shall be made by the approval of a majority of the members present.

rows.source_ko: ⑧ 제1항부터 제7항까지에서 규정한 사항 외에 위원회의 구성ㆍ운영에 필요한 사항은 위원회의 의결을 거쳐 위원장이 정한다.
rows.text_en: ⑧ In addition to the matters prescribed in paragraphs 1 through 7, matters necessary for the composition and operation of the Committee shall be determined by the Chairperson following a resolution by the Committee.
[This Article Newly Inserted Dec. 12, 2014]

rows.source_ko: 제7조(농업농촌통합정보시스템의 구축ㆍ운영 등) 법 제52조의2제1항제3호에서 “농림축산식품부령으로 정하는 업무”란 별표에 따른 업무를 말한다.
rows.text_en: Article 7 (Establishment and Operation of Integrated Agricultural and Rural Communities Information System, etc.) In Article 52-2, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 3 of the Act , “duties prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs” refers to the duties set forth in the attached table .

rows.source_ko: 제3조(농지전용부담금의 납입 등에 관한 경과조치) 농림수산식품부령 제12호 농업ㆍ농촌기본법시행규칙 전부개정령 시행 당시 법률 제6589호 부담금관리기본법 부칙 제4조제2항에 따라 부과하였거나 부과하여야 할 농지전용부담금의 납입 및 징수 대행 등에 관하여는 종전의 농림부령 제1354호 농업ㆍ농촌기본법시행규칙 제5조부터 제9조까지의 규정 및 별지 제1호서식부터 별지 제3호서식까지에 따르며, 같은 규칙 제8조제3항에 따른 농지전용부담금의 납입 시기는 농지전용부담금을 수납한 달이 속하는 분기의 다음 달 10일까지로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Transitional Measures Concerning Payment, etc. of Farmland Conversion Charges) Regarding the  payment and collection agency, etc. of farmland conversion charges imposed or to be imposed pursuant to Article 4, Paragraph 2 of the Addenda to Act No. 6589, the Framework Act on the Management of Charges, at the time of the enforcement of the Enforcement Rules of the Framework Act on Agriculture and Rural Areas, Decree No. 12 of the Ministry for Food, Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries, the provisions of Articles 5 through 9 of the Enforcement Rules of the Framework Act on Agriculture and Rural Areas, Decree No. 1354 of the former Ministry of Agriculture and Forestry, and Forms No. 1 through 3 of the Annex shall apply; and the time of payment of farmland conversion charges pursuant to Article 8, Paragraph 3 of the same Rule shall be the 10th day of the month following the quarter in which the farmland conversion charges were received.

rows.source_ko: 제5조(다른 법령과의 관계) 이 규칙 시행 당시 다른 법령(이 규칙 시행 전에 공포되었으나 시행일이 도래하지 아니한 법령을 포함한다)에서 종전의 「농업ㆍ농촌 및 식품산업 기본법 시행규칙」, 종전의 「농어촌발전특별조치법 시행규칙」 또는 그 규정을 인용한 경우에 이 규칙 가운데 그에 해당하는 규정이 있으면 종전의 「농업ㆍ농촌 및 식품산업 기본법 시행규칙」, 종전의 「농어촌발전특별조치법 시행규칙」 또는 그 규정을 갈음하여 이 규칙 또는 이 규칙의 해당 조항을 인용한 것으로 본다.
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Relationship with Other Laws and Regulations)  Where, at the time of the enforcement of this Rule, other laws and regulations (including those promulgated prior to the enforcement of this Rule but for which the effective date has not yet arrived) refer to the former "Enforcement Rule of the Framework Act on Agriculture, Rural Community and Food Industry," the former "Enforcement Rule of the Special Measures Act on Rural Development," or their provisions, and if there are corresponding provisions in this Rule, it shall be deemed that this Rule or the relevant provisions of this Rule have been referred to in lieu of the former "Enforcement Rule of the Framework Act on Agriculture, Rural Community and Food Industry," the former "Enforcement Rule of the Special Measures Act on Rural Development," or their provisions.

rows.source_ko: 제31조제2항 각 호 외의 부분 중 “「농어업ㆍ농어촌 및 식품산업기본법」에 따른 농어업인 등”을 “「농업ㆍ농촌 및 식품산업 기본법」에 따른 농업인 등과 「수산업ㆍ어촌 발전 기본법」에 따른 어업인 등”으로 하고, 같은 항 제1호를 다음과 같이 한다.
rows.text_en: In the part other than the subparagraphs of Article 31, Paragraph 2, “farmers, fishermen, etc. under the Framework Act on Agriculture, Fisheries, Rural Areas and Food Industry” shall be replaced with “farmers, etc. under the Framework Act on Agriculture, Rural Community and Food Industry and fishermen, etc. under the Framework Act on Fisheries and Rural Development”, and Subparagraph 1 of the same paragraph shall be as follows.

rows.source_ko: 1. 「농업ㆍ농촌 및 식품산업 기본법」에 따른 농업인 및 「수산업ㆍ어촌 발전 기본법」에 따른 어업인
rows.text_en: 1. Farmers under the Framework Act on Agriculture, Rural Community and Food Industry and fishermen under the Framework Act on Fisheries and Fishing Village Development

rows.source_ko: ② 농림축산식품부와 그 소속기관 직제 시행규칙 일부를 다음과 같이 개정한다.
rows.text_en: ② The Enforcement Rules for the Organization of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs and its affiliated agencies are partially amended as follows.

rows.source_ko: 제8조제3항제8호 중 “「농어업ㆍ농어촌 및 식품산업 기본법」”을 “「농업ㆍ농촌 및 식품산업 기본법」”으로 한다.
rows.text_en: In Article 8, Paragraph 3, Subparagraph 8, “Framework Act on Agriculture, Fisheries, Rural Areas and Food Industry” shall be changed to “Framework Act on Agriculture, Rural Community and Food Industry”.

rows.source_ko: ③ 농어촌정비법 시행규칙 일부를 다음과 같이 개정한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The Enforcement Rules of the Agricultural and Fishing Villages Improvement Act are partially amended as follows.

rows.source_ko: 제29조제1항제1호 중 “「농어업ㆍ농어촌 및 식품산업 기본법」”을 “「농업ㆍ농촌 및 식품산업 기본법」 및 「수산업ㆍ어촌 발전 기본법」”으로 한다.
rows.text_en: In Article 29, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 1, “the Framework Act on Agriculture, Fisheries, Rural Areas and Food Industry” shall be changed to “the Framework Act on Agriculture, Rural Community and Food Industry and the Framework Act on Fisheries and Rural Development”.

rows.source_ko: ④ 농지법 시행규칙 일부를 다음과 같이 개정한다.
rows.text_en: ④ Part of the Enforcement Rules of the Farmland Act is amended as follows.

rows.source_ko: 제12조제2항 중 “「농어업ㆍ농어촌 및 식품산업 기본법」”을 “「농업ㆍ농촌 및 식품산업 기본법」”으로 한다.
rows.text_en: In Article 12, Paragraph 2, “Framework Act on Agriculture, Fisheries, Rural Areas and Food Industry” shall be changed to “Framework Act on Agriculture, Rural Community and Food Industry”.

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 농업소득의 보전에 관한 법률 시행규칙 일부를 다음과 같이 개정한다.
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Enforcement Rules of the Act on the Preservation of Agricultural Income are partially amended as follows.

rows.source_ko: 제3조제3호 각 목 외의 부분 단서 중 “「농어업ㆍ농어촌 및 식품산업기본법」 제3조제5호의 농어촌(이하 "농촌"이라 한다)”을 “「농업ㆍ농촌 및 식품산업 기본법」 제3조제5호의 농촌(이하 "농촌"이라 한다)”으로 하고, 같은 조 제4호가목 및 나목 중 “농어촌”을 각각 “농촌”으로 한다.
rows.text_en: In the proviso to the introductory part of Article 3, subparagraph 3, "agricultural and fishing villages under Article 3, subparagraph 5 of the Framework Act on Agriculture, Fisheries, Rural Areas and Food Industry (hereinafter referred to as rural communities)" shall be replaced with "rural communities under Article 3, subparagraph 5 of the Framework Act on Agriculture, Rural Community and Food Industry (hereinafter referred to as rural communities)"; and in items (a) and (b) of subparagraph 4 of the same Article, "agricultural and fishing villages" shall be replaced with "rural communities", respectively.

rows.source_ko: 제5조제2항제2호가목 단서 및 나목 단서 중 “농어촌”을 각각 “농촌”으로 한다.
rows.text_en: In the provisos to Article 5, paragraph (2), subparagraph 2 (a) and (b), "agricultural and fishing villages" shall be replaced with "rural communities" in each case.

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 동물용 의약품등 취급규칙 일부를 다음과 같이 개정한다.
rows.text_en: ⑥ The Rules on Handling Veterinary Medicines, etc. are partially amended as follows.

rows.source_ko: 제6조제2항 중 “「농어업ㆍ농어촌 및 식품산업 기본법」 제3조제4호에 따른 생산자단체”를 “「농업ㆍ농촌 및 식품산업 기본법」제3조제4호 및「수산업ㆍ어촌 발전 기본법」제3조제5호에 따른 생산자단체 ”로 한다.
rows.text_en: In Article 6, Paragraph 2, “producer organizations pursuant to Article 3, Subparagraph 4 of the Framework Act on Agriculture, Fisheries, Rural Areas and Food Industry” shall be changed to “producer organizations pursuant to Article 3, Subparagraph 4 of the Framework Act on Agriculture, Rural Community and Food Industry and Article 3, Subparagraph 5 of the Framework Act on Fisheries and Rural Development”.

rows.source_ko: ⑦ 인삼산업법 시행규칙 일부를 다음과 같이 개정한다.
rows.text_en: ⑦ Part of the Enforcement Rules of the Ginseng Industry Act is amended as follows.

rows.source_ko: 제1조의4 중 “「농어업ㆍ농어촌 및 식품산업 기본법 시행령」 제4조에 따른 단체”를 “「농업ㆍ농촌 및 식품산업 기본법 시행령」 제4조에 따른 단체”로 한다.
rows.text_en: In Article 1-4, “organization pursuant to Article 4 of the Enforcement Decree of the Framework Act on Agriculture, Fisheries, Rural Areas and Food Industry” shall be changed to “organization pursuant to Article 4 of the Enforcement Decree of the Framework Act on Agriculture, Rural Community and Food Industry”.

rows.source_ko: 제3조제4항 중 “「농어업ㆍ농어촌 및 식품산업 기본법」”을 “「농업ㆍ농촌 및 식품산업 기본법」”으로 한다.
rows.text_en: In Article 3, Paragraph 4, “Framework Act on Agriculture, Fisheries, Rural Areas and Food Industry” shall be changed to “Framework Act on Agriculture, Rural Community and Food Industry”.

rows.source_ko: ⑧ 전통주 등의 산업진흥에 관한 법률 시행규칙 일부를 다음과 같이 개정한다.
rows.text_en: ⑧ Part of the Enforcement Rules of the Act on the Promotion of the Industry of Traditional Alcoholic Beverages, etc. is amended as follows.

rows.source_ko: 제3조제3호 중 “「농어업ㆍ농어촌 및 식품산업 기본법」 제3조에 따른 농어업경영체 및 생산자단체”를 “「농업ㆍ농촌 및 식품산업 기본법」제3조에 따른 농업경영체 및 생산자단체와「수산업ㆍ어촌 발전 기본법」제3조에 따른 어업경영체 및 생산자단체”로 한다.
rows.text_en: In Article 3, subparagraph 3, “agricultural and fisheries management entities and producer organizations pursuant to Article 3 of the Framework Act on Agriculture, Fisheries, Rural Areas and Food Industry” shall be changed to “agricultural management entities and producer organizations pursuant to Article 3 of the Framework Act on Agriculture, Rural Community and Food Industry and fisheries management entities and producer organizations pursuant to Article 3 of the Framework Act on Fisheries and Rural Development.”

rows.source_ko: ⑨ 축산자조금의 조성 및 운용에 관한 법률 시행규칙 일부를 다음과 같이 개정한다.
rows.text_en: ⑨ The Enforcement Rules of the Act on the Creation and Operation of Livestock Self-Help Funds are partially amended as follows.

rows.source_ko: 제7조제1호 중 “「농어업ㆍ농어촌 및 식품산업 기본법」 제3조제2호가목”을 “「농업ㆍ농촌 및 식품산업 기본법」 제3조제2호”로 한다.
rows.text_en: In Article 7, subparagraph 1, “Article 3, subparagraph 2, item (a) of the Framework Act on Agriculture, Fisheries, Rural Areas and Food Industry” shall be changed to “Article 3, subparagraph 2 of the Framework Act on Agriculture, Rural Community and Food Industry”.

rows.text_en: ADDENDA <Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs Decree No. 237, Jan. 2, 2017> (Partial Amendment to the Enforcement Rules of the Act on the Management of Traceability of Livestock and Livestock Products, etc., for the Adjustment of Regulations Subject to Sunset)

rows.source_ko: 제1조(시행일) 이 규칙은 공포한 날부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

rows.text_en: Article 2  omitted

rows.text_en: This rule shall take effect on October 25, 2024.

rows.source_ko: 이 규칙은 2026년 1월 23일부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: This rule shall take effect on January 23, 2026.
